quest.title: Miracle Medicine
quest.description: Anthony requested a prescription from a master physician in Liyue Harbor that can be used to heal Anna.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Will this prescription really work...?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What's the matter?

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Traveler! You've got great timing. I was just in a spot of bother.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Here's the thing. You remember my younger sister, Anna, right? She's always been sickly, and nothing's managed to cure her.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: But I heard that there's an incredible doctor in Liyue Harbor who is especially skilled at curing the incurable. So, I asked someone to help me get a prescription from him.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: The ingredients are all very unusual... but I suppose I can only give it a shot.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Um, let me see... Could you help me find a Dendro-Processed Berry?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I have no clue either! Do Dendro Slimes really eat berries...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Either way, I'm counting on you! I do know of a place where both Slimes and berries may be found.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Please help me take a look. I hope you'll find it...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: So you think so too, huh? But I don't have any other options.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I know of a place where you can find both Slimes and berries. Could you please go have a look for me?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I'll try the medication that we make first. No matter what, I can't let Anna's condition get any worse.

choices.text: I could just catch a Dendro Slime for you.

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Huh... What? Are you telling me to stuff the berry into the Dendro Slime's mouth myself?

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: Spare me, please! The last time I went picking herbs for Anna's medication, a group of Dendro Slimes chased me all the way to Springvale!

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: I know of a place where you can find both Slimes and berries. Please go have a look for me, will you? I hope you find something...

response.speaker: Anthony
response.text: But... i—if you really can't find anything, then for Anna's sake... J—Just catch a Dendro Slime and bring it back here. I can do it. I... I will do it!

talks.objective: Check on the state of the berries

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Have you found it yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Please hurry. With Anna's condition, we can't afford to delay...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Have you found it yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Not yet.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Please hurry. With Anna's condition, we can't afford to delay...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Have you found it yet?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yup.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Is that it? It really doesn't look any different...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: However you look at it, this is just an ordinary berry...

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Forget it. Since that's the doctor's orders, let's follow the prescription to the letter.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: Thank you. This is for your trouble.

dialogues.speaker: Anthony
dialogues.text: I might need to bother you again in the future. When that happens, please don't decline.
